Subject: Re: [EXTERNAL] Urgent: production 5xx/429 surge since 07:50 PT

Triage notes (initial):
- Observed pattern: GPU worker pools in ded-west-2 reached sustained 99–100% GPU utilization starting ~07:45.
- Autoscaler logs show repeated launch failures for new workers between 07:45–08:05 due to intermittent provisioning errors in the cloud region; back-off logic meant we did not reach the configured max quickly enough.
- Client retries from StormGate amplified the backlog: many requests were retried with short backoffs, causing a retry storm cluster-side.
- Error signatures: majority are internal 5xx from OOM/queue-drain timeouts; some 429 from per-worker token throttles.

Immediate mitigations applied (09:00):
1) Manually increased pool max from 60 to 85 and forced parallel warm-up of 10 additional workers.
2) Enabled the pre-configured fallback model (quantized variant) for the StormGate route to reduce per-request GPU usage.
3) Temporarily raised per-worker concurrent request cap to reduce 429s while we bring up more workers.

I'm attaching a short CSV with capacity numbers and GPU util slices (capacity_report_Q1.csv). Next steps: validate whether provisioning errors persist (cloud provider incident?) and add autoscaler tuning (shorter ramp policy + controlled aggressive warmup) to the runbook.

Rishi
Senior Infra Engineer, Redwood Inference

Elena — quick update from our side and next steps: 

What we observed and immediate actions taken:
- Root cause (interim): Dedicated GPU worker saturation combined with intermittent provisioning failures in the region led to autoscaler ramp delays. Client retry patterns then amplified the error surface (retry amplification).
- Actions completed: increased pool max to 85, forced warm-up of additional workers, enabled quantized fallback model on the StormGate route, and raised per-worker concurrency caps.
- Outcome: 5xx rate dropped from ~8% at peak to <0.8% over the last 30 minutes; 429s reduced materially. Latency medians moved from ~4.5s to ~1.1s for served requests.

Next items (today):
- 16:00 PT: Post-incident bridge with StormGate SRE to review full logs and timeline (invite sent).
- Engineering to open cloud provider ticket for the provisioning errors and create autoscaler tuning playbook (Aditya/Rishi).
- Redwood will prepare a customer impact summary and proposed service credit if SLA breaches confirm.

Please validate on your side that normal traffic has resumed and flag any remaining failed request IDs so we can trace. We will follow up with a formal RCA within 48 hours.

Apologies for the disruption — we'll keep you updated.

Warmly,
Laura Bennett
Senior Customer Success Manager
